name: Darkest Academia
summary: Unlike the famous Dark Academia , Darkest Academia is characterised by significantly darker tones with the heavy influence of Victorian Goth aesthetic, instead of the "coffee and books" motif.
description:
Unlike the famous Dark Academia , Darkest Academia is characterised by significantly darker tones with the heavy influence of Victorian Goth aesthetic, instead of the "coffee and books" motif. It is usually associated with older times of history and romanticises supernatural and occult, study of magic and mystery instead of classical academic studies. Renaissance , Baroque and Surrealism are the most often associated with Gothic Academia movements of art.

The Gothic academia is usually associated with 16-18 centuries, with books like Faust being one of the core examples. One of the main concepts of aesthetic - the border of study of real science and occult magic - has strongest motifs in 16th century literature like Magia Naturalis or De Miraculis Mortuorum . Works of later authors like H.P. Lovecraft also partially fall into the aesthetic of Gothic Academia, as almost all of them posses relevant elements of forbidden knowledge, mystery, occultism and learning.

Darkest Academia is often incorrectly seen as a subtype of Dark Academia, with many people associating themselves with Dark Academia, although they in fact adore Gothic Academia's aesthetic. It originated slightly earlier, becoming popular and recognised primarily at the same time as Vampirecore , in early 00's, instead of mid 10's.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Intellectualism, mystery, research, occultism, death, immortality

fashion.Overview: A typical outfit, featuring more modern elements. The fashion of Gothic academia is very similar to Vampire and Victorian Goth, sometimes with more archaic elements. It is usually defined by elegant, dark clothes customary to late medieval/early Renaissance scientists, like dark gothic capes, coats, high collars, and draped hoods. The look can range from rich and aristocratic to modest and humble, not necessarily connected to a certain time period.

environment.Overview: Faust, the most famous example of the Darkest Academy character Unlike other styles of academia, Darkest Academia more focuses on individual life of solo-scientists, hermits or very closed off from the outside world, sometimes suffering from mental disorders, uncovering and encountering mysteries of science and magic. The aesthetic is often set around teachers and professors instead of students, though a more typical academia life is also presented. Morals and motifs can range from "Universe is mysterious and magical" (like in Faust ) to "Universe is incomprehensible and vast" (like Lovecraft ).
